domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by an occupational noise exposure compliance programme: how a dosimeter survey becomes a regulatory exposure figure (criterion level, exchange rate, threshold, projection to the shift, TWA, action level and limit, ceiling and impulse exceedances) and how similar-exposure groups are judged. The deliverable is the programme's compliance report, not software behaviour for its own sake; acoustics physics is limited to the dose formula the programme fixes, so Science/Physics would misplace the judgement, which is the compliance reading of the manual.
evidence: instruction.md: the manual is 'the authority for this compliance report'; symptoms are compliance outcomes (group short of the limit, impulse never flagged, long shifts under-reported)

environment/app/docs/noise-survey-manual.md: a numbered hearing-conservation programme manual with action level, exposure limit, ceiling and impulse rules and flagged departures from the federal occupational noise rule
planned verifier (step 4 onward): whole-report comparison of per-worker and per-group dose, TWA, status and flags against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, which is derived from the manual
task.toml: category Operations, subcategory Compliance, tag regulatory-compliance-reporting echoes the gloss
